scope: A4 integrated arc energy and finite prescribed Gibbs/survival balance, preparing weighted A8.
assumptions: Finite real Hilbert/Borel space, six standing assumptions hα,hαβ,hV,hH,hη,hβη identical93–97; arbitrary y,r,z, n≥0,T≥0 and strict ordered tuple.
source_density: U_y(x,p)=V(x)+||x-y||²/(2η)+||p||²/2; w_y=exp(-U_y), ν=constant_y*w_y relative to ell. U_y differs from conserved shifted harmonic energy H_y,r.
source_derivative: d/ds U_y(Phi_s z)=sqrt(η)<p_s,h_r(x_s)>=λ_r(Phi_s z)-λ_r(R Phi_s z), every real s.
bounce: U_y(S_r z)=U_y(z); U_y(Rz)=U_y(z). Holds including zero normals; no rate positivity needed.
arc_balance: U_y(Phi_b z)-U_y(Phi_a z)=integral a..b [λ_r(Phi_s z)-λ_r(R Phi_s z)]; continuity guarantees interval integrability.
finite_balance: For actual prescribed Gamma, A=Gamma(T), I+=integral0..T λ(Gamma_s), I-=integral0..T λ(R Gamma_s): U_y(A)-U_y(z)=I+-I- and w_y(z)*exp(-I+)=w_y(A)*exp(-I-).
jump_factors: A5 matches each incoming rate to reversed incoming rate after the corresponding original bounce. This is a separate finite-word/event matching obligation. Zero-rate prescribed events allowed.
weighted_consumer: After proving reverse-path arc/AE matching and jump-product matching, D(z,t)=w_y(z)*pathDensity(z,t) is invariant under Theta97. Theta97 volume MP then yields weighted sector integral substitution; A795 + stationary averaging/Tonelli later yields bounded bilinear balance.
normalization: Pointwise homogeneous balance uses explicit unnormalized w, no normalizer premise. To obtain probability invariance later, connect ν as normalized density and prove/consume normalizability separately.
path_convention: Actual Gamma uses post-bounce values. Reverse comparison valid off finite event times or using left limits, never full pointwise right-continuous reversal. Integrals insensitive to finite endpoints.
zero_cases: n0 is single arc; T0,n0 gives zero integral/identity; T0,n>0 empty; rank0 phase singleton; zero-normal bounce identity.
